$comment: Single source of truth for README section order. Each entry maps a profile source file to its sequence position and filename number. Generated files carry number: null by design (see previous rename) and stay pinned by position. To reorder sections, move entries here and re-run pnpm readme — no code edits needed. Files present in profile/*.md but missing here are appended alphabetically by build-readme.mjs.
